classes.NUM: numeral (stroke count); short strokes count items, tall strokes count standard units
classes.LINK: grammatical link between an institution and its holder
classes.AFF: great household or institution named at the opening of a legend
classes.NAME: element of a personal name
classes.COMM: commodity, unit, department or counted item
classes.TITLE: office or role noun

attribute_rules.official: class AFF or TITLE, or code 400 or 621
attribute_rules.locality: local for NAME and COMM; pan for NUM, LINK, AFF, TITLE, DET
attribute_rules.stock: NAME/COMM only: H if >=45% of discovery tokens on TAB:B or TAB:I; MD if >=30% on TAB:C

band_rules.position: over distinct intact single-line texts of length >=2: final if final share >=0.40; else initial if initial share >=0.30; else medial
